newsitem.title: USA: Actor Timothy Dalton cheers Labour win.
newsitem.headline: Actor Timothy Dalton cheers Labour win.

text.p: British actor Timothy Dalton, whose movie roles James Bond, said on Thursday he was "very happy" at the apparent landslide win for Tony Blair's Labour Party in the general election.
Dalton, speaking before results of Britain's election were made official, said "...it's going to be the biggest Labour victory since the Second World War and that's thrilling, I'm very happy."
He made brief comments to the media hours before Prime Minister John Major, leader of the Conservative Party, conceded defeat.
He was in Washington to attend a Democratic National Committee fund-raising dinner in honor of President Bill Clinton.
"I support the Labour Party, just as I support the Democratic Party in this country," he said.

Dalton, a British citizen who resides in the United States, said while he supported Blair he did not vote for him via absentee ballot because "you have to apply so far ahead of time and I never know where I'm going to be.
